title: Matchday Pilot v2 page spec
description: One spec per page TEMPLATE (not per rendered instance). Declares the page's blocks, each block's backing dbt mart, and the i18n keys it uses, so a build-time checker (site_v2/scripts/check-page-specs.mjs) can refuse to build a page with no spec or a spec that references something that does not exist. Shape rules here are mirrored by hand in check-page-specs.mjs -- keep the two in sync. See docs/content_architecture.md for the block library this sits on top of.

page.description: The page template's source path, relative to site_v2/src/pages/ (e.g. "[lang]/teams/[team].astro").

entity.description: The entity type this template renders, per docs/content_architecture.md section 2.

block.description: Block name, taken verbatim from the "Block" column of docs/content_architecture.md section 3 -- no new vocabulary.

mart.description: The backing dbt mart model name, e.g. "mart_team_profile" (or an array when one block is genuinely backed by more than one mart, e.g. content_architecture.md's "Squad / roster" row = mart_roster + mart_player_career). Every value must exist as a real file under dbt_project/models/5_marts/**.

i18n_keys.description: A representative (not required to be exhaustive) sample of i18n keys this block uses, from site_v2/src/i18n/strings.ts. Every LISTED key must exist in the EN dict; the checker does not require every key a block's components use to be listed here.
